svg.title: Logger hierarchy: where refunds.debug goes
svg.desc: Loggers root (INFO), app (unset), web (unset, effective INFO), payments (DEBUG) and refunds (unset, effective DEBUG). root has appender root-out, payments has payments-out. A debug record from refunds is accepted because its effective level is DEBUG, then delivered to payments-out and, through additivity, to root-out without checking root's INFO level.
svg.text: refunds.debug(...) is decided once, at refunds
